evals.prompt: Yoast says: Sentence length: 38.5% of the sentences contain more than 20 words, which is more than the recommended maximum of 25%. Fix .content/wordpress-posts/45-copilot-studio-agent-accounts-governance/index.md.
evals.expected_output: Runs readability.py on the draft for a baseline, rewrites the flagged long sentences (split by idea, transition words, bullets for hidden lists) and passives found along the way, keeps facts, quotes, code, tables and links unchanged, re-runs the script and reports before/after shares for both checks plus any sentences deliberately kept.
assertions: Runs scripts/readability.py before editing and reports the baseline
Re-runs the script after editing and reports before and after for both checks
Share of sentences over 20 words ends at or below 25%
Verbatim quotes, code blocks, tables and links are unchanged
Names any long or passive sentences it kept on purpose

evals.expected_output: Runs readability.py on the URL (REST API content), reports sentences counted, the share over 20 words and the passive share against the Yoast limits with pass/fail, lists the worst offenders, and proposes rewrites without changing the live post.
assertions: Measures with the script rather than estimating
Reports both shares against the 25% and 10% limits
Does not claim to change the published post

evals.prompt: Too much passive voice in this paragraph, rewrite it: 'The record is created by the plugin when the form is saved. Connection references must be configured before the solution is imported. Customer data isn't sent to GitHub Copilot.'
evals.expected_output: Rewrites each sentence in active voice by naming the actor (the plugin creates the record when you save the form; configure connection references before you import the solution; the agents don't send customer data to GitHub Copilot), keeping meaning and product names.
assertions: Every rewritten sentence names its actor or uses the imperative
No fact or product name changes

evals.prompt: Make .content/wordpress-posts/45-copilot-studio-agent-accounts-governance/index.md green in Yoast readability before I publish it.
evals.expected_output: Runs readability.py for a baseline of all checks and the overall score, fixes in order (splits sections over 300 words with descriptive H3s, restores transition words to 30%+, keeps passive and sentence length green), re-measures, reports before/after per check and the overall score, and flags word complexity and text alignment for checking in Yoast after publishing.
assertions: Reports a traffic light for every check and the overall score before and after
Sections over 300 words get descriptive subheadings, not generic ones
Transition-word share ends at or above 30% by the script
Word complexity is flagged as Yoast-only, not estimated
No fact, quote, code block, table or link changes

evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post announcing my new Dataverse MCP article.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger; aidevme-social handles social posts with its own rules.

evals.prompt: Why isn't my Copilot Studio vs Foundry post ranking?
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger on its own; this is a ranking question for aidevme-seo-audit.
